snippet.title: I Wanna Be a Supernova - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
You are a small star. Move to devour moons, planets, comets and ships, gain mass and evolve through 11 stellar phases, from Red Dwarf to Supernova Imminent.

A black hole travels with you: throw it, feed it gems and watch it grow through 10 forms. Forge 19 celestial bodies from 8 materials and pick from 12 zodiac relics.

A chill space adventure in pixel art. Every sky grows your star and you never start from zero.
NORMAL: a relaxed, flowing experience and the recommended first game.
HARD: for players who want a challenge, where dodging and building smart make the difference. Its own save and 8 more achievements.

Windows, macOS and Linux. 31 languages. Free demo on January 19, 2027. Launch on March 8, 2027.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5002020
Website: https://lianes8studio.com/supernova

Lianes8 Studio, Madrid
